what_this_measures: Within one reference stratum of a two-by-four table, whether the stratum size, both index-test marginals (i.e. both sensitivities) and a published McNemar chi-square identify the stratum's four cells.

singular_case_equal_marginals.description: When the two sensitivities are equal the discordant cells are equal, the chi-square is 0 for every discordant total, and the statistic adds nothing.
